title: de-stress-lab: Selection-aware stress tests and frozen prediction ledgers for scientific likelihoods
description: Installable research software for grouped-observation likelihoods, deterministic model comparison, leave-group-out influence diagnostics, selection-aware null calibration, and cryptographically frozen prediction ledgers. Includes a DESI DR2 cosmology flagship demonstration, numerical equivalence tests, public documentation, and an explicit AI-usage disclosure.
